title: Can I BEAT Jupiter 2011 Chess?
summary: A chessboard shaped like a spaceship map (rooms such as the cafeteria joined by corridors). White escorts three astronauts (Speed, Creek, Queso) to the escape pod at the end of the longest rank while ~30 red 'Keys', all moving like queens, hunt them. Each turn only a couple of random Keys move, each one some distance closer to the astronaut nearest to it, so being in check is a probability game. In the video's single game Speed and Creek are caught and only Queso escapes; the pod then launches.
rules: Board: irregular spaceship map (rooms + corridors) on a brown chess.com board over a dark grey void; the escape pod sits at one end of the longest rank (12:55 'the absolute longest rank').
White = player: three astronauts plus ordinary escort pieces (queen, rooks, knights, bishops, pawns seen in frames).
Astronauts step one square like a king and can capture Keys (7:01 'I can simply capture it using Creek', 9:05). [king-step inferred from 'adjacent square' / 'walk him over'].
Keys are black pieces that move and capture like queens (0:35).
Each turn only a couple of Keys move (0:56), picked at random; a picked Key that sees an astronaut captures him; 3 attackers out of ~30 keys ~ a 1 in 10 chance (3:11).
Keys move some distance closer to whichever astronaut is nearest to them and do not coordinate (4:00).
Keys can also take the other white pieces (1:33 'hopefully none of our other pieces get captured') [inferred].
The pod holds several astronauts; one already aboard scoots over to make room (11:30, 12:14).
Goal: get at least one astronaut home through the escape pod; all three is the ultimate victory (0:03, 2:09). The pod launches with a countdown (14:05).
win_condition: At least one astronaut aboard the escape pod when it launches (app: launches automatically when every surviving astronaut is aboard, or by the Launch pod button). Loss: all three astronauts captured.
